prompts.wind-shuttle/run:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent game sprite animation atlas, FOUR columns by FOUR rows, square canvas.
Primary request: redraw an anatomically correct continuous FOURTEEN-FRAME run cycle, not fourteen copies of a stride pose.
Image1 is the EXACT POSE AND LAYOUT AUTHORITY: fourteen numbered technical mannequins in row-major order, last two cells EMPTY. Cyan is anatomical NEAR leg/arm; purple is FAR leg/arm. Copy each mannequin's joint positions and silhouette, not its colors, labels, diagrams, or flat style.
Image2 is the approved character identity/style reference. Image3 is the existing run sheet only for clothing/color/face proportions, NOT its gait.
Layout: 4x4 equally sized cells. Exactly fourteen full isolated bodies: rows1-3 have4 each; row4 has2 in LEFT cells only; row4 right two cells transparent empty. No other figures. Square canvas. Bodies same scale and approximately70%cellheight; hands/boots/hair remain inside each cell with empty gutters.
Camera/body facing: ALL FOURTEEN bodies face screen RIGHT, elevated orthographic southeast three-quarter profile. Nose points RIGHT throughout. Never mirror body direction for the second half.
Gait is a FULL cycle with two anatomical legs taking turns. Read row-major:
0 near leg reaches forward and touches ground, far leg behind, near arm behind.
1 near leg bears weight and bends, torso drops slightly, far heel curls back.
2 near foot now underneath body while supporting, FAR knee swings under pelvis.
3 near leg is behind hip still supporting; FAR knee clearly PASSES FORWARD with boot raised directly UNDER torso. Narrow passing silhouette, NOT wide stride.
4 NEAR toe pushes behind torso, FAR knee high forward with bent shin. Near arm now forward.
5 airborne, FAR shin extends forward, NEAR foot folds behind; subtle torso rise.
6 FAR heel reaches low forward to land; NEAR knee starts recovery behind.
7 FAR leg touches ground forward, NEAR leg behind. Same yaw; anatomical limbs trade roles.
8 far leg bears weight, torso drops, near heel curls back.
9 FAR foot supports beneath body, NEAR knee swings under pelvis.
10 FAR leg behind hip supporting; NEAR knee clearly passes FORWARD under torso; narrow silhouette.
11 FAR toe pushes behind torso, NEAR knee high forward, shin bent.
12 airborne, NEAR shin extends forward and FAR boot folds behind.
13 NEAR heel reaches forward preparing frame0 contact; cycle closes smoothly without repeated final frame.
Crucial silhouette changes: contact frames0/7 wide stride; pass frames3/10 feet near torso center; push frames4/11 one knee visibly forward and one toe back; flight5/12 both feet off ground. Opposing arms follow anatomical leg roles. Preserve subtle hair/jacket secondary motion.
Style: approved playful hand-painted 2.5D cartoon sports athlete, dark navy outline, crisp cream/color blocks, chunky sneakers, warm upper-left light. No change in identity or costume between frames.
Transparent ALPHA in every gap. No text, frame numbers, grid, watermark, ground, shadow, football, trails, FX or props. Technical diagram must not appear in output.
Character: Wind Shuttle: slim teal-haired adult female runner, cream cropped sports jacket with teal cuffs, dark loose trousers, chunky cream/teal wing-accent sneakers, mischievous smile. Light springy run.
